description: Search registered Community designs (RCD) at the EUIPO — "find registered EU designs owned by Adidas in Locarno subclass 02.04 (footwear)". Locarno classes must be class.subclass in the form "02.04" (a bare class such as "02" is refused; look subclasses up with euipo_search_product_indications). Use for design-filing landscape and competitor design portfolios. Returns matching designs (design number, indication of product, status, owner, Locarno classes, filing date) plus raw. Example: euipo_search_designs({ owner: "adidas", locarno_classes: ["02.04"], status: "REGISTERED" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own EUIPO client_id:client_secret; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

indication.description: Indication of product / design keyword to match (wildcards added automatically), e.g. "footwear".

locarno_classes.description: Locarno class.subclass codes, each exactly two digits, a dot, two digits, e.g. ["02.04", "09.01"]. A bare class ("02") is refused; find subclasses with euipo_search_product_indications.

owner.description: Design owner / applicant name to match, e.g. "adidas".

query.description: Advanced: raw RSQL filter passed through verbatim, NOT a free-text search (a plain word is refused; use indication for keywords). Example: productIndications=="*footwear*";locarnoClasses=in=(02.04). Overrides the friendly params above.

status.description: Design status filter. "REGISTERED" means REGISTERED_AND_FULLY_PUBLISHED plus REGISTERED_AND_SUBJECT_TO_DEFERMENT. Other accepted values: EXPIRED, SURRENDERED, DESIGN_DECLARED_INVALID, INVALIDITY_PROCEDURE_PENDING, LACK_OF_EFFECTS, or the two REGISTERED_AND_* values directly. Comma-separate for multiple.

name: euipo_search_designs
title: Euipo Search Designs
